title: Changelog mini‑tour visual asset pack for release blog and quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Deliver a focused image pack used by the March release blog and quickstart docs that illustrates the new onboarding mini‑tour, feature callouts, and before/after UI states. Deliverables must include: hero banner (1200x600), three annotated screenshots for blog feature callouts (desktop, tablet, mobile sizes), before/after comparison set with delta highlights, a condensed GIF walkthrough (6–10s) showing the onboarding mini‑tour, and a plain white-background screenshot set for thumbnails. Each image must include layered Figma source with export-ready slices and clear alt text suggestions.

Scope details: produce both light and dark mode variants, redact PII/sample keys in screenshots, include copycall overlays for two key selling points ("Faster cold-starts" and "Transparent token breakdown"), and provide a 1:1 mobile mock for the quickstart flow. Optimize exports for web (WebP and PNG fallback). Add accessible alt text and short captions for the docs team.

Acceptance criteria: all images pass design review, assets uploaded to Drive under /Design/Release_2026_03/Changelog_Pack, Figma file contains named frames matching export filenames, and engineering samples for README include markdown-ready image tags and a short usage guide for blog authors. Delivery must also include a 6‑frame sprite sheet for in-console micro-animations.
